sentences.text: Heard o n I.A. No.8659 of 2024, which is third application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C for suspension of sentence filed on behalf of appellant - Suraj.

The appellant has been convicted for the offence punishable under Section 363, 376(AB) of IPC and sentence to undergo 03 years RI and 20 years R.I. with fine of Rs.1000/- and Rs.5000/- with default stipulations respectively.
Earlier first interim bail application was disposed of vide order dated 22.05.2023 and second bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 29.08.2023.
The appellant has only suffered 2 years & 2 months jail sentence out of 20 years rigorous imprisonment.
The age of the prosecutrix has been found 06 years and the DNA report is also against the present appellant.
There is no changed circumstances for considering the application for suspension of sentence.
Accordingly, I.A. No.8659 of 2024 is dismissed.
